prompt.generated_prompt_string: A clearly adult woman at a fictional international film festival premiere, centrally positioned and gazing directly at the camera with a poised serene expression. She has strawberry-blonde hair in long loose natural waves draping over her shoulders, dewy natural makeup with soft pink lips and subtle shimmer, realistic skin texture, and wears an ethereal lavender and soft-blue couture ensemble: a strapless structured bodice covered in heavy silver leaf-like crystal embroidery, a delicate shimmering floral or vine embroidery detail across the midsection, and a voluminous tiered pale-lilac tulle skirt. Add a prominent architectural silver statement ring on the right hand. Use a softly blurred red carpet with photographers and onlookers, no recognizable people, logos, or watermarks. Bright directional event lighting highlights the crystals, with soft fill and elegant bokeh. Capture a full vertical portrait and close-up editorial crop using an 85mm portrait lens or 100mm macro lens, realistic skin pores, delicate fabric texture, restrained lilac color, and fine grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted anatomy, malformed crystals, recognizable public figures, text artifacts
